selection: Uncompressed raw AVI; cleaner background and fewer clipped highlights than the supplied contrast variants.

sensor_dot_repair.method: Interpolate only zero-valued samples from the most consistent opposing immediate neighbours before denoising; healthy samples unchanged.

render.antialiasing: Bicubic supersampling of signed schlieren detail before nonlinear contrast mapping; no frame interpolation or extra sharpening.
render.geometry: Crop, position, zoom and cell calibration remain in original 628 x 480 recording coordinates.

theme_cleanup.reference: Median of the identically denoised pre-wave frames; same 0.45 px smoothing as each frame.
theme_cleanup.residual_cleanup: Adaptive pre-wave noise floor, gentle attenuation of weak texture, coherent wave-edge protection; no additional temporal filtering.
theme_cleanup.grey_treatment: Unchanged; retains the original grey background and existing mild denoising.

note: Visual calibration for banner continuity; not measurement data. See site/src/components/banner/clip.ts for trajectory anchors.
